# Figure inventory (generated by `amlr figures` / `amlr prisma` from the latest snapshot)

Each section that owns a figure places it with a `figure` (column width) or `figure*`
(page width) environment, writes the caption, and refers to it with `Fig.~\ref{...}`.
Graphics path: `figures/<file>`.

| Label | File | Width | Content | Owner section |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| fig:prisma | figures/prisma_figure.tex (already placed after results_overview; caption fixed) | column | PRISMA 2020 flow of study selection | results_overview (refer to it) |
| fig:growth | growth.pdf | column | included studies per publication year, stacked by platform class | results_overview |
| fig:taxonomy | taxonomy_overview.pdf | page (figure*) | taxonomy overview: heat map of platform class x collective phenomenon (study counts; a study counts under each of its phenomena), with marginal totals per platform (top) and per phenomenon (right) | platforms |
| fig:interaction | subtaxonomy_interaction.pdf | page (figure*) | sub-taxonomy: interaction modality, bars stacked by platform class (multi-label) | platforms |
| fig:theory | subtaxonomy_theory.pdf | column | sub-taxonomy: theory compared (multi-label), stacked by theory-experiment agreement (quantitative / qualitative / none) | theory |
| fig:control | subtaxonomy_control.pdf | column | sub-taxonomy: control architecture, stacked by the largest hardware collective (2-9, 10-99, 100-999, >=1000 agents) | control |
| fig:validation | validation_agreement.pdf | column | sensitivity, specificity and Cohen's kappa of the LLM panel, R1, R2 and Claude Opus against the author's final labels on the 200-record title/abstract validation sample; dashed line = 0.95 sensitivity threshold | methods |
